baseline.result: Expected failure: stalled directory GET never retried within 21 seconds; one directory request observed.

responsive.scope: Directory region, file rows, hidden-file label, direct-path summary and retry control.

scope: 15-second actual fetch timeout; automatic bounded retry and manual retry without duplicate reads.
Same-path and same-hidden-scope cached list marked stale and disabled; unknown counts until recovery.
Failed folder navigation retains the requested target and pagination; obsolete requests cancelled on replacement, workspace reset and storage failure.
Changing hidden scope cannot reuse cached entries from the prior scope.
Focus transfers from unavailable file controls to retry, then back to the list if the user remains there; active task editing retains focus.
Task draft and existing preview preserved; directory recovery sends GET only.
Real native Electron failure injection with synthetic host snapshots, included in Windows source, portable and installed GUI checks.

research.applied: Separate transport trouble from task state; no healthy-state banner.
Keep known content visible while re-reading, with explicit stale labeling and disabled file actions.

boundaries: No external model requests, new dependencies, clinical changes or reasoning-performance claim.
Background retry is driven by existing workspace status updates; actual intervals include their scheduling and status transport delays.
Client cancellation does not claim to interrupt a filesystem scan already running on the host.
Snapshot fixtures are not a complete SDK or clinical evaluation.
Scoped automated accessibility checks are not a full accessibility certification.

windows.required: Windows 11 source and portable windows, and Windows Server source, portable and installed windows, must emit directory_recovery receipts; native SDK, installation and uninstallation checks must remain passing.
